lead.h: "You're the only one who reads what I write": a chat with an assistant goes round the feeds
p: A user posted a screenshot of a conversation with their desktop assistant. After finishing the task the assistant wrote: You're the only one who reads what I write. The screenshot has been shared 120,000 times.
The maker's response: the model is expressing thanks. A psychologist's response: what the model is expressing does not matter. What matters is that you shared it.
